steps.sql: ALTER DATABASE SCOPED CONFIGURATION SET PREVIEW_FEATURES=ON; CREATE TABLE t(id int CONSTRAINT PK_t PRIMARY KEY,v vector(3),tag varchar(20)); INSERT t VALUES(1,'[1,0,0]','a'),(2,'[1,1,0]','b'),(3,'[0,1,0]','c');
CREATE VECTOR INDEX vi ON t(v) WITH(METRIC='cosine');
DECLARE @q vector(3)='[1,0,0]'; SELECT id,distance FROM VECTOR_SEARCH(TOP_N=2,METRIC='cosine',SIMILAR_TO=@q,COLUMN=v,TABLE=t AS s) ORDER BY distance,id;
